verdict.rationale: Every skill's SKILL.md must include a `name` and `description`. Codex starts from each skill's name and description and loads the full instructions only when it decides to use the skill, so the description is the documented activation surface. The skill creator explicitly asks what the skill does and when it should trigger, and developers can inspect skills via `/skills` or the Skills sidebar. Community users raise skepticism about how predictable free-form Markdown skills are, but that is not concrete contrary evidence. Missing for 10: a required, structured 'when it activates' field separate from the free-text description; any review or enforcement that installed plugin skills accurately describe their triggers; deterministic or inspectable activation behavior; independent hands-on confirmation that descriptions reliably predict when skills activate.
